description: Suggest a website as a trusted source: a government food database, or the official site of one brand or restaurant chain. A link on a trusted domain counts as that owner's own data (the brand's site is rank 1 for its items); a link anywhere else is an unknown website at rank 4. A person checks and approves every domain; this never approves one. Free, capped per day.

domain.description: The domain, or any URL on it: "clifbar.com" or "https://www.clifbar.com/products/...".

entity_id.description: For brand: the brand or chain (br_ or rs_), or any of its items; the item's brand is used.

trusted_for.description: government: a public food-composition or label database. brand: the official site of one brand or restaurant chain.

why.description: How you know it is the official site: printed on the package, named in a regulator record, linked from the brand's own page.

name: suggest_domain
